notes.title: RELEASE DATE CONFIRMED: SEPTEMBER 22, 2025
notes.notes:
[p]Attention, Dreamers! [/p][p]We're thrilled to announce that [b]HYPERxFANTASY[/b] officially launches [b]September 22, 2025[/b]:     [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/embed/_dDpvnWXJKg"][/dynamiclink]  [/p][p]As you may have figured out, the main creator Surcutt-P got imprisoned inside HYPERxFANTASY by a character he created - the overpowered overlord named the Arch-Executer. So prepare on Monday to help him, or he'll be stuck there forever![/p][p][/p][p][b]Here's a sneak peek at what you'll do while helping Surcutt-P:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Find Your Adept[/b]
Choose a candidate for Ascension. Otherwise they'll take Yui. You wouldn't want that.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Navigate the Humanity Expo[/b] [/p][p]From Execution Chambers to Critter Village. Each location holds secrets that may be better not to tell the Arch-Executor about... Or you can tell her and see for yourself...[/p][p][/p][p][b]Complete Wish Contracts[/b][/p][p]Fulfill the final wishes of Spherius and Teé. Your choices determine who ascends... and who departs.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Manage Your Companions[/b] [/p][p]Yui and Enris will keep you company, along with the little floating tyrant named Todd (attached to your chest, he looks like a machine-toddler). But maybe they have their own agendas - be careful.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Remember - it all starts Monday, September 22, 2025.[/b][/p][p]Wishlist the game if you haven't already. It helps a lot.[/p][p][/p][p]See you in HYPERxFANTASY![/p]
